description: Android permission registry, mirrored from app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml. Every entry documents why the permission exists and how the user stays in control. Noxs never requests permissions at startup; capability commands ask at use time.

permissions.name: INTERNET
permissions.purpose: Rootfs download, APT, code-server, NX package system, AI providers.
permissions.user_control: Standard Android permission; no user action required.

permissions.name: ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
permissions.purpose: Connectivity summary for 'noxs network status' and download pre-checks.

permissions.name: FOREGROUND_SERVICE / FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC
permissions.purpose: Keeps the terminal/runtime service alive during installs and long transfers.
permissions.user_control: Notification shown while the service runs.

permissions.name: WAKE_LOCK / VIBRATE
permissions.purpose: Reliable long-running installs and terminal feedback.

permissions.name: POST_NOTIFICATIONS
permissions.user_control: Asked when the user posts or taps 'noxs notification permission'.

permissions.name: READ_MEDIA_IMAGES / READ_MEDIA_VIDEO / READ_MEDIA_AUDIO
permissions.purpose: Gallery import ('noxs document gallery') and media access via the Android bridge.
permissions.user_control: Asked on first use of the matching command; revocable in Settings.

permissions.name: READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE / WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
permissions.purpose: Legacy direct-storage path on old Android versions only.
permissions.user_control: Asked at use time; SAF is preferred on every supported version.

permissions.name: CAMERA
permissions.user_control: Asked right before the camera opens; revocable in Settings.

permissions.name: MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
permissions.purpose: OPT-IN direct /sdcard mount ('noxs storage grant --direct' + 'noxs storage mount'). NOT used for normal operation; SAF is the recommended model.
permissions.user_control: User-approved in Android's own All-files-access screen; default off; revocable from either side at any time.

permissions.name: MANAGE_DOCUMENTS
permissions.purpose: android:permission attribute on the NoxsDocumentsProvider element — the platform standard for document providers. It lets Android's own file UIs browse the Noxs Linux home; it grants Noxs nothing extra.
permissions.user_control: Access happens only through Android's document UIs; no runtime dialog involved.

permissions.name: SMS (none requested)
permissions.purpose: Noxs holds NO SMS permission. Sending hands the message to the system SMS app where the user presses send; contacts are picked through Android's own picker.
permissions.user_control: Final approval always happens outside Noxs.
